text:
The Ambassador of India to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952 was Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, not K. M. Panikkar (who served 1952–1953) or Vijayalakshmi Pandit (Nehru's sister, who was Ambassador to the USSR 1947–1949 before moving to Washington). The note's claim is therefore incorrect for the 1949–1952 period.  
CONFIDENCE: 80
